title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・先を行く者よ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross wins the autumn Tenno Sho with a spectacular performance that has everyone in the stands on their feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One is also swept up in the excitement and swears to catch up with her one day.
